description: Image Description: The image depicts an empty classroom with a simple and clean layout. The room is well-lit, with natural light streaming in through two large windows on the right side of the image. The walls are painted in a light blue color, giving the space a calm and inviting feeling. The classroom contains several rows of wooden desks and benches with metal frames, arranged neatly in a grid pattern. The floor appears to be made of a light-colored material, possibly concrete, adding to the minimalist aesthetic.
